title: When loneliness closes the room in as a steady practice
issueStatement: The heart feels unaccompanied even when people are nearby. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru joins belonging to remembrance, Sangat, and the nearness of the One. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: Neediness is not rejected here. It is brought honestly into the Guru's care. Name the companionship the line is restoring before the mind insists it is alone.
actionPrompt: Name the companionship the line is restoring before the mind insists it is alone. Repeat what you can actually keep.
